result: Leo sketched a fish on the pad, facing left with its tail on the right. Hana caught a flaw early: the run started at the nose, so Leo rebuilt it to begin at the top of the tail. Tom took the belly after Hana asked, "Tom, yes or no?" Priya bridged a loose joint at START. Then Maya found the real break: a domino below the vertical sat off-line and cut off everything beneath it. Omar's bottom fin stopped at the tail point, but its end faced up with nothing ahead, so Tom had to tie the belly into it. Grace's earlier "closed" call on the nose proved premature, and she admitted it: "Nobody push on my say-so." In the end, 97 of 176 fell. Everyone at the table called it a fish, but the blind judges guessed a swan, a hook, or a wave.
